title: tempo-kpi-orchestrator-and-launch-sprint-conductor
summary: Working canvas for coordinating sprint-level KPIs, tempo-driven milestones, and the operational readiness checklist for upcoming product launches. Focus is on creating a repeatable cadence ("conductor") that maps sprint commitments to measurable signals and automated gating.
objectives: 1) Define a minimal set of sprint KPIs tied to launch success (quality, latency, cost, adoption). 2) Create a reusable readiness checklist that lives in the runbook and is lightweight enough to validate in each sprint. 3) Surface clear decision triggers for canary/playback/rollback. 4) Reduce verification time by standardizing metrics and ownership.
kpi_definitions:
- P95 inference latency (ms): measured at token-complete boundary for canonical workloads; target <= 250ms for hosted tier.
- Unit cost (USD / 1M tokens): rolling 7d average, target improvement X% vs baseline.
- Canary success rate (%): proportion of canary requests without correctness/regression alerts (passes automated evals + manual checks).
- Prompt quality delta (BLEU-ish / custom eval): median quality score vs golden prompt set; regression threshold: -3 points.
- Error ratio (5xx + model-fallbacks / total): target < 0.2% at full traffic.
- Activation adoption (DAU within 7 days): % of beta cohort who used feature at least once; target 35%+ for initial launch.
- Escaped bugs (customer-facing post-launch): count; target 0 for critical, <=2 for major in first 72h.
roadmap_rows: Sprint 1 (Week A-B): baseline measurement + golden prompt set curation; deliver: canonical test harness, canary traffic route (10%) configured; owners: Avery (metrics), Rajat (routing)
Sprint 2 (Week C-D): implement batching and caching recommendations for target model family; deliver: perf flags, A/B toggle in console; owners: ServingRuntime + DeveloperDX
Sprint 3 (Week E-F): dry-run canary with synthetic load; deliver: canary pass criteria validated, automated rollback script tested; owners: SRE (Samir), Product-Ops
Sprint 4 (Week G): external beta with 100 customers; deliver: adoption telemetry + feedback loop; owners: Customer Success, Product
Sprint 5 (Week H): full rollout gating and SLA post-check; deliver: go/no-go decision board and async comms play; owners: Eng leads + PM
readiness_checklist:
- Metrics pipeline: streaming telemetry to dashboard (tokens, latency, errors) confirmed and tagged.
- Canary route: traffic split configured and monitored with alerting.
- Quality harness: golden prompts + automated evals uploaded and green.
- Cost guardrails: budget alert thresholds created for unit-cost spikes.
- Rollback plan: validated snapshot + automated rollback steps documented.
- Support runbook: triage ownership, escalation phone tree, Slack shortcuts in place.
- Compliance signoff: security review completed for private/dedicated deployments if applicable.
- Console routes: experiment toggles live for canary/A-B/feature-flag use.
- End-to-end test pass: smoke test for major flows executed in staging and green.
- Customer comms draft: pre-bake status page, release notes, and kb article outline.
rollout_stages:
- Stage 0: Internal dry-run (0% external traffic) — validate pipelines and smoke checks.
- Stage 1: Canary (5-15% traffic) — automated checks + manual spot-checks.
- Stage 2: Beta cohort (limited customers) — measure adoption, collect qualitative feedback.
- Stage 3: Phased ramp (25%, 50%, 100%) — incremental SLO verification at each gate.
- Stage 4: Full production — enable monitoring cadence and cost stabilization window (72h).
risk_mitigation:
- Risk: sudden token-cost spike. Mitigation: auto-throttle policy + alert to cost-ops; fallback to lower-cost quantized model variant.
- Risk: model regression on intent recognition. Mitigation: block rollout (auto-fail canary) + fast rollback; assign eval owner to triage and patch prompts.
- Risk: region capacity shortage. Mitigation: route to secondary region per smart-routing policy; notify solutions-engineering.
- Risk: customer-visible downtime. Mitigation: swap to degraded mode (shorter context, cached responses) and engage SRE on-call.
owners_and_responsibilities: Product Ops (Maya): conductor for readiness cadence; run decision board; ensure playbook completeness
Applied ML (Rajat): quality harness + regression triage; owns golden prompt sets
Serving Runtime (Avery): perf experiments, batching flags, kernel toggles
SRE (Samir): canary automation, rollback scripts, alerting configuration
Customer Success (Lena): beta cohort coordination, feedback collection, comms
open_questions:
- What is the exact improvement target for unit cost this quarter (product + finance alignment needed)?
- Do we require a separate compliance checklist for customers on Dedicated vs Hosted? (security signoff path)
- Agree on canary pass threshold: 98% automated checks + zero critical regressions? Draft for decision board.
- Should we allow temporary model variant fallback for high-severity outages or force immediate rollback? Pros/cons to discuss.
next_steps: 1) Sync with finance on cost target (ASAP, assign PRD line item). 2) Wire up golden prompt set to the metrics dashboard (owner: Rajat, due: 2025-10-10). 3) Run internal dry-run this week and capture 10 smoke run artifacts for postmortem. 4) Draft customer beta invite and CS playbook (owner: Lena). 5) Schedule decision board for Sprint 3 end.
